title: I made a mobile game, Tuckaway Games
author: Hads84
selftext:
Frustrated by games being filled with ads or dark patterns with energy mechanics I set about making a mobile game containing various card, board and puzzle games.

I settled on Flutter as the technology as I'm already familiar with that framework and multi platform support would be helpful later.

Using Chat GPT Codex I fairly quickly had a prototype working.

I then decided to release it on play store for others to enjoy, this process despite what I felt a bit draconian actually proved to be valuable.  I had to have 12 testers for 14 days before I could apply for production, so I had friends and colleagues install it and several even provided amazing feedback resulting in a lot more polished product.

I vibe coded the entire thing, but used the ponytail skill to ensure it didn't create a mess, I've spot checked the code here and there and it seems really reasonable.  I don't have the mental capacity to review or write code outside of work, as I do that all day for my day job.

Anyhow, if you have any questions about the process etc, feel free to ask.

Here is a link to my game anyhow, [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nz.co.hads.tuckaway\_games](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=nz.co.hads.tuckaway_games)

It is free for a few of the games, or a once off purchase of roughly $1 USD to unlock the full suite of games which at the moment stands at 58.
